info.title: Paperclip API
info.description: REST API for the Paperclip AI agent management platform

BoardSessionAuth.name: paperclip_session
BoardSessionAuth.description: Board session cookie in authenticated mode. Paperclip uses Better Auth; cookie transport may vary by deployment.

BoardApiKeyAuth.description: Board API key presented in the Authorization bearer header.

AgentBearerAuth.bearerFormat: Agent API Key or Agent JWT
AgentBearerAuth.description: Agent API key or Paperclip-issued local agent JWT presented in the Authorization bearer header.

RuntimeToolsBearerAuth.description: Scoped token bound to an active heartbeat run and presented in the Authorization bearer header. The GitHub credential endpoint requires the distinct github_credentials scope.

AgentRunAuth.description: Paperclip-issued JWT bound to an active task run. Agent API keys, board sessions, and connection-only tokens are rejected.

post.description: The optional repositoryIds field selects GitHub source repositories and requires a board caller. It cannot be combined with workspace. All selections are validated before the project and repository workspaces are created atomically.

get.description: Use `view=compact` for the board issue-list row contract. The default response remains the broad compatibility contract.

get.summary: List agent configurations for a company

patch.description: When posting a comment, attachmentIds selects up to 20 unique uploaded attachments from this exact task and company. The comment, attachment binding, and issue update commit atomically. attachmentIds without a comment is rejected; Markdown links alone do not bind uploads.
